note: DRAFT devnet profile (2026-11-18). Nothing here has been deployed. Every <SET-BY-R0ZE...> value is a placeholder that r0ze fills in; the dry-run refuses to send while any placeholder is left. No key material is ever stored here: only public addresses and file paths given on the command line.
programId: <SET-BY-R0ZE: program address (public key of the program keypair r0ze creates offline)>
upgradeAuthority: <SET-BY-R0ZE: upgrade-authority public key (offline key; also the only AnnounceSeason signer, I-51)>

program.soLenCapSource: frontier-abi/src/v2/budgets.rs PLACEHOLDER_SO_LEN_S1: the L(kind) loaded-data limits of the S1 program are computed for a .so no longer than this
program.minSolanaCli: 4.0.0 (plan.mjs MIN_SOLANA_CLI): the CLI verifies the ELF with its own syscall table before sending, and 3.1.x does not know sol_curve_decompress / sol_curve_pairing_map. The build stays on cargo-build-sbf 3.1.9.

rent.why: devnet's current rate was not read (no devnet contact allowed). 6960 is the pre-SIMD-0437 rate and the highest of the staged feature gates set_lamports_per_byte_to_{6333,5080,2575,1322,696} (agave master feature-set/src/lib.rs; v3.1.9 has none of them), so it is the conservative bound. The code's own figures use 5080 (frontier-abi presets comments).

fees.writeChunkNote: bytes per loader-v3 Write transaction. With a fee payer and a separate upgrade (= buffer) authority the CLI's calculate_max_chunk_size leaves about 876 B [derived from agave v3.1.9 cli/src/program.rs, not run]; 850 is the conservative figure (fewer bytes = more transactions = a higher estimate). Each Write carries two signatures: the fee payer's and the authority's.
